'''Dasch Nilraan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Knight-Captain]] in the [[Knights of Zakuul]].<ref name="Chapter 8" />

In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Battle of Asylum]] between the [[Eternal Empire]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Outlander.<ref name="Chapter 8" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dasch Nilraan was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]], where he first appeared in Chapter 8: Taking Flight.<ref name="Chapter 8" />
